title: Gate release provenance on TUI replay
purpose: Make TUI-oriented readiness a release/provenance gate instead of an informal claim.
scope: Update build-release.ps1 to require TUI replay evidence.
Record TUI replay hash, TUI config hash, command registry hash and QEMU TUI marker status.
Add promotion blocker when replay is missing, failed or stale.
Preserve existing functional, ecosystem and QEMU gates.
acceptance_criteria: Release gate blocks TUI-oriented promotion when TUI replay is missing or failed.
Provenance records deterministic TUI evidence hashes.
QEMU TUI-ready marker is represented in release evidence.
failure_modes: Release can claim TUI-oriented readiness without replay.
Provenance omits TUI config or command registry hash.
TUI replay failure is downgraded to warning.
